source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, Enemy stat blocks (provisional, item 52); Endurance and spare magazines added for injuries, ammo and stealing (provisional); technique lists by tier (rules 1.12, provisional, item 950); Calls by tier (rules 1.13, provisional); rules 1.15: every enemy has a level (the `levels` table), the tier rows are the level 1 numbers, a damage factor by tier, the Vermin tier (provisional, items 1015 to 1024); the table fitted with the fight simulator (items 1025 to 1030); rules 1.23: healer_focus by tier (provisional, item 1302); rules 1.25: a fire doctrine by tier, `doctrine`, `fire_spread` and `fire_near` (provisional, items 1400 to 1404); rules 1.34: owned_weight (how much less a Figment draws its fire) and double_save (none: always fooled by a Double; else the Brain save's penalty), provisional, items 2170 to 2172

items.name: Vermin
items.text: Small things in a swarm: one hit kills one at equal level, and each bites weakly.

levels.note: Rules 1.15 (balance pass, step 1). An enemy's numbers are its tier's row in `items` (the level 1 numbers) raised by its level's row here: HP = hp x hp_mult and armour = armour x armour_mult (both rounded), Defense = defense + defense_plus, attack bonus = attack_bonus + attack_plus, damage dealt = the weapon's (or spell's) damage x the tier's `damage` x damage_mult. Companions use the same rows at their owner's level. Fitted with the fight simulator (docs/design/handoffs/balance-sim-step1.md): HP grows a little faster than armour, so a Soldier takes 3.5 of the plain rifleman's hits at level 1 and just under 4 from level 12. The working is in the spec (Rules revision 1.15).
levels.fight_level: the average level of the characters in the fight, rounded down

full_hp_guard.text: No single action by a character takes an Elite or a Boss of their level or higher from full HP to nothing: it is left on 1 HP. Not a Miracle, a trap, a hazard, a field or a turret.

gap.note: An enemy this many levels below the character who hurts it is taken out by any hit that deals damage. For each level between an enemy and a character, the higher gets +to_hit_per_level to hit the other and the lower the same as a penalty, to max_levels.

companions.name: Combat drone
companions.provisional_note: HP 30, the service pistol, shoot only and infinite ammo are settled (Leon, 7 Nov 2026; spec 14 item 370). Defense, attack bonus, armour and Movement stay provisional.
companions.text: A Drone Handler's drone: it acts right after its owner, on the owner's orders: it moves and it shoots, nothing else (no aimed shot, burst, Overwatch, reload or jam clearing). Its service pistol never runs dry: no reloads, no Heat, no jams. At 0 HP it is destroyed, not Downed; Field Repair or a workshop brings it back.

companions.name: Beast companion
companions.provisional_note: HP 60 is settled (Leon, 7 Nov 2026; spec 14 item 370). Defense, attack bonus, armour and Movement stay provisional.
companions.text: A Beast Handler's animal: it acts right after its owner, on the owner's orders. At 0 HP it is out (destroyed for the fight); rest and care bring it back.

companions.name: the twin
companions.text: A Twinbound's twin, called on the area map: a token with its own 4 AP a round, spent only on moves, never more than 6 tiles from its owner. HP half its owner's maximum and its owner's Defense (the numbers here are stand-ins the engine replaces). A fight opened on the area map starts with it beside its owner as the called twin.

casters.name: Sigil novice
casters.text: A drill-yard Evoker with a knife for when the words run out: SPARK at range, MEND on a hurt ally (two-word spells; Max Sigil words 2).

casters.name: Sigil adept
casters.text: A soldier who writes rather than shoots: FIRE lobbed into a cluster (KIN when its own stand there too), BIND or SLOW on whoever charges in, MEND on the hurt, STEP out of a melee. Max Sigil words 3.

casters.name: Sigil warden
casters.text: An elite Evoker with a sabre: CHAIN lightning through a squad, FREEZE and SLOW on the fast ones, WARD and MEND on its line, NULL on the fields, turrets, traps and walls you leave in its way, a hidden trap on the tiles you'll cross, STEP out of reach. Max Sigil words 4.

casters.name: Sigil magister
casters.text: A champion who gives orders to the air and to you: the boss tier's nine words (FIRE, SHOCK, SEEK, ARC, SPREAD, CHAIN, KIN, WARD, NULL) with ACID, CONDENSE, MEND, STEP and COMMAND. It walks you out of its guards' reach, halts whoever charges, takes a shooter's weapon off them, burns a cluster with KIN to spare its own, and NULLs what you leave on the ground. Max Sigil words 4.

casters_note: Enemy Sigil casters (rules 1.4, spec 14 items 469 and 491): a fight's foe naming one of these by `caster` gets its tier's stat block, this weapon and an Evoker with these words (Max Sigil words by tier, sigils.json enemy_ai.max_words). spell_bias multiplies the value the AI puts on a spell when it weighs it against its weapon. Provisional.

soul_casters.name: Heart adept
soul_casters.text: A soldier who fights from the chest: Begins a Raw Heart bolt when it has the AP, Pumps with what it doesn't spend shooting, and lets it go at whoever walks into 4 tiles (Heart Overwatch). A Mending pulse for a hurt squadmate. It steadies or lets go before its heart burns (Strain limit 4).

soul_casters.name: Heartfire elite
soul_casters.text: An elite with a sabre and a burning heart: it holds a Fire Outburst and walks into you, so its aura scorches whoever stands next to it; it drops a Heartfire burst on a cluster (Burning from stage 2; at stage 4 the fire spreads and the ground burns) or a Cinder wave into a line at close range, and an Ember mend on its own around it. One free Pump a round (as Empathy 3); Strain limit 5.

soul_casters.name: Heart sovereign
soul_casters.text: The fight's centre, a heart you can see filling: a Storm Sovereign lance through a line of you (chains at stage 2, two chains and Shaken at 4), a homing Rime bolt that Slows and at stage 4 Pins, a Gale heart that throws everyone next to it away, and Sovereign's grace on its hurt guards. Two free Pumps a round (as Empathy 7), reach +1, Strain limit 6: it holds for the big release when you bunch up, and watches with the heart when you close in.

soul_casters_note: Enemy Soul casters (rules 1.5, Outburst 2.0; ai-soul.ts): a fight's foe naming one of these by `caster` gets its tier's stat block, this weapon and an Emanator with these ready designs (school, modules, tone, as a player's), this Soul multiplier, MP, Strain limit and free Pumps a round (as Empathy; Will Power for its rolls is its tier's attack bonus). The AI Begins, Pumps, holds for a big release, watches with the heart, Steadies or lets go before the burn, and heals with Buff designs, through the engine's own previewOutburstPlan. Provisional (the damage balance pass).

ai.about: Rules 1.37 (Classes 3.0 step 9; combat.ts enemy turn): how the enemy AI reads the four new systems. Behaviour only, no HP or damage number. figments_last: the tiers that take a Figment (one that is not Loud, not a Double that fools it) only when no character is in reach (figments-spec 8: Soldiers shoot Figments only with no character in reach; Elites and Bosses ignore them); the AI previews no Figment while a character is in reach. shelter: a target standing in a zone of this kind of its own side counts as this many times its HP to the doctrine's 'most hurt' (a Sanctuary halves damage: 2); a shield (a Ward) counts as HP the same way. held_risk: what a held attack the enemy's side can see being held (an Overwatch, a Killzone, a Blade's Hold) adds to a walk that crosses it, as Anchor's opportunity attack does. healer_tie: the kind of tie whose holder an enemy at its far end takes for the other side's healer whatever it has healed (bonds-spec 8: a Bonded enemy turns on its Bonder; an Elite or a Boss hunts it). boss_hidden_rounds: a Boss is never Hidden after this round (shadow-spec 8.1: it can't hide, and one still Hidden is revealed as the next round starts). skulk_open: what a skulker adds to a tile the other side has in view when it closes in (it flanks through cover rather than walk into the open). Provisional, items 2400 to 2409.
